method:
Estimate the earlier direct-five-VC source footprint from a checked snapshot.

Use --baseline-dir PATH for a git-archive snapshot of --baseline, with its lake
packages/toolchain available and `lake build Sal.MRDTs.Paper1.Ledger` completed.
No checkout/build is created automatically. Counts are nonblank, noncomment
source lines in kernel dependency closures, not person-hours. Commuting cases
use specialized old raw VC applications, excluding certificate history fields.

counter.baseline_raw_expression: (ConcreteMRDT.CommutingPort.mergeVCs (Instances.FlatCounters.all_comm (fun _ : Unit => (1 : Int))) (Instances.FlatCounters.mergeLaws (fun _ : Unit => (1 : Int))) (Instances.FlatCounters.deltaLaws (fun _ : Unit => (1 : Int))) (Instances.FlatCounters.commutingPeelLaw (fun _ : Unit => (1 : Int))))

increment-only-counter.baseline_raw_expression: (ConcreteMRDT.CommutingPort.mergeVCs (Instances.FlatCounters.all_comm (fun _ : Instances.FlatCounters.IOCOp => (1 : Int))) (Instances.FlatCounters.mergeLaws (fun _ : Instances.FlatCounters.IOCOp => (1 : Int))) (Instances.FlatCounters.deltaLaws (fun _ : Instances.FlatCounters.IOCOp => (1 : Int))) (Instances.FlatCounters.commutingPeelLaw (fun _ : Instances.FlatCounters.IOCOp => (1 : Int))))

limitations: Source footprint estimate, not development time or independent implementation count.
Actual raw-VC closures include complete declaration headers/bodies; implementation and contract definitions, shared framework, and independent sequential bridge fields are excluded.
Named-case rows overlap; only campaign union is additive.
Old commuting callers are measured from actual original call lines, while proof terms specialize their old law-bundle assembler.
